stem: A secondary spray bottle contains a diluted cleaning chemical but has no identifying label. What is the strongest response?
choices: Stop using the container until it is identified and labeled according to the site's hazard-communication requirements
Use it if the liquid color looks familiar
Smell the bottle to identify the chemical
Write only the word 'cleaner' and resume work
rationale: Unidentified chemical containers create preventable exposure and misuse risk; workplace labeling should communicate the identity and applicable hazards.
